systems.name: 5.1 Mesh Editing & Modifiers
systems.notes: Use mesh tools like extrude, bevel, loop cut, and Boolean operations.
tasks: Extrude a face multiple times to create a shape
Use the mirror modifier for symmetrical models

systems.name: 5.2 Vertex Colors & Shaders
systems.notes: Add vertex colours and basic shader effects (glow, transparency).
tasks: Paint vertex colours on a mesh
Make parts of the model transparent
Enable emissive rendering for glowing areas

systems.name: 5.3 Import & Refine Existing Models
systems.notes: Import a .obj/.glb from another tool and clean it up in Blockbench.
tasks: Import an external model (e.g., from Sketchfab)
Optimise the mesh (remove doubles, fix normals)
Apply a new texture set to the imported model
